data_controller.heading: Data Controller
data_controller.paragraph_1:
We are the data controller for the processing of personal data concerning our customers and business partners. You can find our contact information below:
Improve Invest A/S
Strandvejen 125
2900 Hellerup
CVR: 44720795
If you have questions about the processing of your personal data, you can contact us via info@improveinvest.com

processing_activities.heading: Processing Activities
processing_activities.paragraph_1: As a data controller according to the GDPR, we have the following processing activities.

website_visit.heading: Website Visit
website_visit.paragraph_1: When you visit our website, we use cookies to enable the website to function, which you can read more about in our cookie policy.

communication_with_potential_customers.heading: Communication with potential customers
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_1:
If you have questions about our site, or wish to hear more about our services, you can contact us via:
Contact Form
Email
Phone
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_2: Through this, we will process your personal data so that we can engage in a dialogue with you, e.g., answering questions about our services. We only process the information you provide us in connection with our communication.
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_3: We will typically process the following common information: name, email, and phone number.
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_4: Our legal basis for processing this personal data is Article 6(1)(f) of the General Data Protection Regulation.
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_5: We delete our communication with you when it becomes clear whether you want our services or not.
communication_with_potential_customers.paragraph_6: Should the need arise in a specific case to store your personal data for a longer period, this may be the case.

customers.heading: Customers
customers.paragraph_1: When you become an investor in Improve Invest A/S or otherwise enter into a customer relationship with us, we process the personal data necessary to establish, administer and document the customer relationship. This may include, among other things, name, address, contact details, CPR number (Danish civil registration number), bank and custody account details, information about investments and payments, and other information necessary to administer your ownership and communicate with you. We process the information for purposes including investor administration, communication, capital increases, distributions, general meetings, reporting and compliance with our legal and regulatory obligations. Investor onboarding and customer due diligence. In connection with the establishment and ongoing administration of an investor relationship, we may process further information to meet requirements regarding customer due diligence, identification and documentation. This may include, among other things: identification documents and identity information, information about beneficial owners and ownership structure, information about investment amounts and payment circumstances, information necessary to assess whether the investor meets the conditions for investing in the fund, documentation of the investor’s risk acknowledgement where relevant, and, where applicable, information about the origin of funds. Processing takes place when necessary to comply with legal obligations to which Improve Invest A/S is subject, or when processing is necessary to enter into or administer the agreement with the investor. Storage. We store personal data for as long as necessary for the purposes for which the data was collected, and thereafter for as long as we are required to do so under applicable law. Information relating to investor and customer relationships is therefore not necessarily deleted immediately after the customer relationship ends. Information may be stored for the period required by accounting, company, tax and anti-money laundering legislation and other relevant regulatory requirements.
customers.paragraph_2: The legal basis for processing this personal data is Article 6(1)(b) of the General Data Protection Regulation.
customers.paragraph_3: Once the service has been delivered and any outstanding matters are concluded, we will delete the personal data immediately thereafter.

newsletter.heading: Newsletter
newsletter.paragraph_1: We have a newsletter which is voluntary to subscribe to – and you can always unsubscribe from it again.
newsletter.paragraph_2: The purpose of the newsletter is to send subscribers emails with new information from the company, which may concern new content on the website and the announcement of our services.
newsletter.paragraph_3: We will only send you emails if you have given your active consent for this. This primarily requires you to state your email address, to which we then send an email so that you can confirm the subscription. In this way, we ensure that you have actually signed up for the newsletter yourself, i.e., provided active consent.
newsletter.paragraph_4: Our legal basis for processing your personal data (i.e., the email address) in connection with the newsletter will be Article 6(1)(a) of the General Data Protection Regulation.
newsletter.paragraph_5: We will process your personal data as long as you are still subscribed to the newsletter. Upon unsubscribing from the newsletter, we will also stop sending it to you. If we have not sent you a newsletter for 1 year, your consent will lapse as a result of our inactivity.
newsletter.paragraph_6: Upon unsubscribing from the newsletter, we store your now former consent for 2 years after it was last used due to statute of limitations requirements according to section 11.3 of the Consumer Ombudsman's spam guide.

accounting.heading: Accounting
accounting.paragraph_1: We must store all accounting documents according to the Danish Bookkeeping Act (bogføringsloven). This means we store invoices
accounting.paragraph_2: and similar documents for accounting purposes. These may contain common personal data such as name, address, service description.
accounting.paragraph_3: Our legal basis for processing personal data for accounting is Article 6(1)(c) of the General Data Protection Regulation.
accounting.paragraph_4: We store this information for a minimum of 5 years after the current financial year has ended.

job_applications.heading: Job Applications
job_applications.paragraph_1: We gladly accept job applications with the aim of assessing whether they match a recruitment need in our company.
job_applications.paragraph_2: If you send your job application to us, our legal basis for processing your personal data is Article 6(1)(f) of the General Data Protection Regulation.
job_applications.paragraph_3: If you have sent an unsolicited application, we will immediately assess whether your application is relevant and then delete your information again if there is no match.
job_applications.paragraph_4: If you have sent an application for an advertised job, we will dispose of your application if you are not hired, and immediately after the right candidate has been found for the job.
job_applications.paragraph_5: If you are part of a recruitment process and/or are hired for the job, we will provide you with separate information on how we process your personal data in this context.

data_processors.heading: Data Processors
data_processors.paragraph_1: Few can handle everything themselves, and the same applies to us. We therefore have partners and use suppliers, some of whom may be data processors.
data_processors.paragraph_2: External suppliers may, for example, provide systems to organise our work, services, consulting, IT hosting, or marketing.
data_processors.paragraph_3: It is our responsibility to ensure that your personal data is processed properly. We therefore place high demands on our partners, and our partners must guarantee that your personal data is protected.
data_processors.paragraph_4: We therefore enter into agreements for this with companies (data processors) that handle personal data on our behalf to enhance the security of your personal data.

disclosure_of_personal_data.heading: Disclosure of Personal Data
disclosure_of_personal_data.paragraph_1: We do not disclose your personal data to third parties.

profiling_and_automated_decisions.heading: Profiling and Automated Decisions
profiling_and_automated_decisions.paragraph_1: We do not perform profiling or automated decisions.

third_country_transfers.heading: Third-Country Transfers
third_country_transfers.paragraph_1: As a starting point, we use data processors in the EU/EEA, or who store data in the EU/EEA.
third_country_transfers.paragraph_2: In some cases, this is not possible, and here data processors outside the EU/EEA may be used if they can provide adequate protection for your personal data.

processing_security.heading: Processing Security
processing_security.paragraph_1: We keep the processing of personal data secure by having implemented appropriate technical and organisational measures.
processing_security.paragraph_2: We have conducted risk assessments of our processing of personal data and have subsequently implemented appropriate technical and organisational measures to increase processing security.
processing_security.paragraph_3: One of our most important measures is to keep our employees updated on GDPR through ongoing awareness training, a GDPR course, and by reviewing our GDPR procedures with the employees.

rights_of_the_data_subjects.heading: The Rights of the Data Subjects
rights_of_the_data_subjects.paragraph_1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have a number of rights in relation to our processing of information about you.
rights_of_the_data_subjects.paragraph_2: If you wish to exercise your rights, you must contact us so that we can help you with this.

right_of_access.heading: Right to Access Information (Right of Access)
right_of_access.paragraph_1: You have the right to access the information we process about you, as well as a number of additional details.

right_to_rectification.heading: Right to Rectification (Correction)
right_to_rectification.paragraph_1: You have the right to have inaccurate information about yourself corrected.

right_to_erasure.heading: Right to Erasure (Right to be forgotten)
right_to_erasure.paragraph_1: In special cases, you have the right to have information about you erased before the time of our general deletion occurs.

right_to_object.heading: Right to Object
right_to_object.paragraph_1: In certain cases, you have the right to object to our otherwise lawful processing of your personal data. You can also object to the processing of your information for direct marketing.

right_to_data_portability.heading: Right to Data Portability
right_to_data_portability.paragraph_1: In certain cases, you have the right to receive personal data about you that you have provided to us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, and to request that the data be transferred to another data controller where the conditions for this are met.

withdrawal_of_consent.heading: Withdrawal of Consent
withdrawal_of_consent.paragraph_1: When our processing of your personal data is based on your consent, you have the right to withdraw your consent.

complaint_to_the_danish_data_protection_.heading: Complaint to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet)
complaint_to_the_danish_data_protection_.paragraph_1: You have the right to file a complaint with the Danish Data Protection Agency if you are dissatisfied with the way we process your personal data. You can find the contact information for the Danish Data Protection Agency at www.datatilsynet.dk.
complaint_to_the_danish_data_protection_.paragraph_2: We generally encourage you to read more about the GDPR so that you are updated on the rules.

purpose.heading: 1. Purpose
purpose.paragraph_1: This policy has been prepared in accordance with: Executive Order on requirements for information and consent for the storage of or access to information in end-users' terminal equipment and aims to ensure that end-users of the Company's website (improveinvest.com & improveinvest.dk) are protected against unlawful storage and disclosure of their information. The Company's websites use cookies to provide end-users with the best online experience. When the end-user uses our desktop and mobile website and accepts this policy, they consent to the use of cookies in accordance with these terms.

cookie_definition.heading: 2. Cookies
cookie_definition.paragraph_1: A cookie is a text file containing a data sequence that is sent from a web server to a web browser and stored by the browser. When a website is visited, the site is saved on the user's computer, mobile, or similar with the purpose of recognising the user the next time they visit the website. Cookies cannot be used to run programs or send viruses to the user's computer. Some cookies remain on the user's computer after they have closed the browser, while others are deleted after 30 minutes or when the browser is closed.

block_3.cookie_policy_intro: The Company may use the information received via visitors' cookies for the following purposes:
block_3.cookie_policy_a: To recognise the user's computer when they visit the Company's websites
block_3.cookie_policy_c: To analyse the use of the website
block_3.cookie_policy_d: To tailor the website to the user
block_3.cookie_policy_e: To track the user while they navigate the website
block_3.cookie_policy_outro: The Company does not use cookies for marketing on third-party sites.

complaints.heading: 4. Complaints
complaints.paragraph_1: Complaints about the Company's use of cookies can be addressed to info@improveinvest.com

entry_into_force.heading: 5. Entry into Force
entry_into_force.description: This version of the cookie policy is effective from 21/8/2026.

hero.headline: Value creation through disciplined real estate investments

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest A/S invests in properties in the capital. Value is created through disciplined analysis, renovation, and the conversion of commercial buildings into residential units.
paragraphs.p2: As an investor, you gain access to a focused real estate strategy based on local market insight, structured decision-making, and clear exit frameworks.

read_more.text: Read about our decision model – MIRA

why_invest.heading: Why invest with Improve Invest?
points: Systematic value creation through renovation and conversion
Focused real estate investment in one of Europe's most in-demand housing markets
Minimum investment is DKK 750,000
Invest with company funds, pension funds, free funds or VSO (Danish business tax scheme). The optimal choice should be clarified with your own adviser.
Risk diversification via investment in a portfolio of buildings
More than 20 years of experience with real estate and investment
Registered with the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority as a manager of alternative investment funds (AIF)
why_invest.disclaimer: *Historical returns are not a guarantee of future returns.

market_strategy.heading: One market. One strategy. Clear discipline.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest focuses on the capital as its investment area.
paragraphs.p2: The capital is characterised by high and sustained demand for housing, high liquidity and clear project exit opportunities. Changing work patterns, fewer office spaces, and reduced physical retail have created significant potential for converting existing commercial properties into housing.
paragraphs.p3: By focusing on a single market, Improve Invest achieves deep local insight, a strong network, and the ability to precisely assess risk. This reduces complexity and increases predictability in both execution and realization.
paragraphs.p4: Housing in attractive urban areas has historically seen stable demand. This makes the capital a natural focal point for a disciplined and risk-aware real estate strategy.

investment_model.heading: The model behind the investments
investment_model.sub_heading: A fixed decision model behind all projects

paragraphs.p1: All investments are assessed and managed according to a fixed decision model that ensures consistent analysis, disciplined risk assessment, and clear exit scenarios – before capital is committed.
paragraphs.p2: The model is the core of Improve Invest. Our way of working. Our experience shows that only about one in 80 assessed cases meets our requirements.

read_more.text: Read more about MIRA – our decision model

points.heading: 1. Selective selection
points.description: Properties are selected based on location, potential uses, and demand in the capital – and are often found via our own network.

points.heading: 2. Renovation and conversion
points.description: Projects are executed within fixed frameworks, using our own partners and ongoing quality and budget control.

points.heading: 3. Realization and reinvestment
points.description: The properties are sold, and capital plus returns are reinvested into new projects.

buildings_with_identity_and_potential.heading: Buildings with identity and potential
buildings_with_identity_and_potential.sub_heading: History as part of the selection
buildings_with_identity_and_potential.paragraph: Improve Invest often invests in properties with character and a clear historical identity. These are buildings that are solidly constructed, attractively located, and suitable for new use.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest A/S is registered with the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority as a manager of alternative investment funds (AIF).
paragraphs.p3: Improve Invest has a professional board of directors that handles the company's overall governance, strategic supervision, and risk control.
paragraphs.p4: The board includes Christian Klarskov and Chairman of the Board Karsten Holst Bork Kristoffersen, an attorney specializing in corporate and capital market law.
paragraphs.p5: We cooperate with external advisors within auditing, tax, and law to ensure correct structure and ongoing control.
paragraphs.p6: The partners have invested their own capital in the fund.

ctas.contact: Contact us for a non-binding dialogue

section_1.subheading: Improve Invest A/S is a Danish asset manager with a clear method for value creation through property conversions and renovations.

paragraphs.p1: The strategy is to create attractive returns through the renovation and conversion of properties – primarily former commercial buildings – into private homes in areas with documented high demand.
paragraphs.p2: The company invests purposefully in one market and according to one consistent strategy. This allows for deep local insight, structured decision-making, and a high degree of control throughout the entire investment process.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest's business model is active value creation. The return is generated through concrete improvements and conversions of the properties – not by awaiting general price increases in the market.

points: selective choice of properties with conversion or improvement potential
execution of renovations within fixed frameworks for quality, time, and finance
realization through sale

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest has chosen the capital as its sole investment area. This choice is based on structural demand for housing, high liquidity, and clear exit options.
paragraphs.p2: Focusing on one market is a strategic choice and a central part of the company's risk management.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest typically invests in properties that sit between smaller private investors and large institutional players. These projects are often too complex for smaller investors and too specialized for institutional funds – providing access to a market with limited competition and the opportunity for active value creation.
paragraphs.p2: Improve Invest invests in properties in the price range of DKK 15-200 million. This provides diversification in the number of properties and risk diversification.

paragraphs.p1: All projects are assessed based on fixed principles for location, conversion potential, risk profile, and exit. Only a small proportion of the assessed opportunities are executed as investments – selectivity is a crucial part of the approach.

Improve Invest often invests in properties with character and historical identity. History is not the basis for investment in itself, but is part of the assessment, as buildings with identity often command high demand and good liquidity upon realization.

points: Focused real estate investment in the capital
Active value creation through renovation and conversion
Clear method and disciplined selection
Investment in multiple projects with risk diversification
Professional setup with clear frameworks

section_1.subheading: A fixed framework for all investments

paragraphs.p1: MIRA is Improve Invest's fixed decision model for investing in real estate. The model is applied consistently across all projects and ensures that investments are assessed, executed, and realized according to the same discipline and principles.
paragraphs.p2: MIRA stands for Model for Investment, Renovation, and Return Analysis and has been developed based on many years of practical experience with real estate investments.
paragraphs.p3: When Improve Invest executes a project, it is because it has passed MIRA.

paragraphs.p1: Real estate investment involves many variables – including location, price, regulatory conditions, scope of renovation, and exit options. MIRA was developed to create structure in these decisions and ensure that all projects are assessed equally, regardless of size and complexity.

points: consistent analysis and decision basis
disciplined deselection of projects
documentation of key assumptions and risks

paragraphs.p1: MIRA follows the investment through the entire process – from initial assessment to realization.
Before a property is acquired, MIRA is used to assess the project's fundamental prerequisites.

p2.subheading: This involves analyzing, among other things:
points: location and local demand
entry price in relation to usage options
potential for renovation or conversion
key risks and alternative scenarios

paragraphs.p3: The purpose is to ensure that the investment has a clear and realistic basis before capital is committed.

paragraphs.p1: Once the investment is made, MIRA is used as a management tool through the renovation and development phase.

points: adherence to budget and schedule
defined frameworks for quality and execution
ongoing follow-up on identified risks

paragraphs.p3: This ensures that value creation occurs in a controlled manner and in accordance with the original assumptions.

paragraphs.p1: Before realization, the project is assessed again in MIRA with a focus on exit.

points: assessment of market and demand
concrete exit scenarios
possibility of temporary leasing as an alternative

paragraphs.p3: This ensures that value creation occurs in a controlled manner and in accordance with the original assumptions.

paragraphs.p1: MIRA is an internal decision model and not a standalone product. It was developed to ensure discipline, consistency, and transparency in the work with real estate investment over time.
paragraphs.p2: In other words, it is a central part of the company's way of working – built to bind Improve Invest's investment strategy, risk management, and cases together in one common framework.

section_1.subheading: How an investment in Improve Invest works

paragraphs.p1: Investing in Improve Invest is structured, clear, and based on a transparent process.

points.heading: We identify and analyze a project
points.description: A real estate project is thoroughly assessed according to our decision model, MIRA. Only projects that meet the requirements for location, risk, and return are executed.

points.heading: Capital expansion opens
points.description: When Improve Invest A/S expands its capital, interested investors get the opportunity to become co-owners of the company and thereby all ongoing projects.

points.heading: Free funds, pension, or VSO
points.description: Investment can be made with private capital, via the Business Tax Scheme (VSO), or pension funds. The specific frameworks are always reviewed individually.

points.heading: You contact us and invest
points.description: The investment takes place via a direct dialogue where we ensure that Improve Invest is relevant for you and that the terms are clear. Investments can be made using free funds, pension funds, or the Business Tax Scheme.

points.heading: Projects are executed on an ongoing basis
points.description: Properties in the portfolio are renovated or converted within fixed frameworks for time, quality, and finance, with ongoing management and control.

points.heading: Realization
points.description: When a project is finished, the value is realized through sale.

points.heading: Capital and return
points.description: Returns are reinvested into new projects.

paragraphs.p1: All investments involve risk. At Improve Invest, risk is handled systematically through fixed principles applied across all investments.
paragraphs.p2: Improve Invest A/S’ shares are unlisted. The investment has no capital protection, and the investor may lose all or part of the investment. The summary risk indicator is 4 out of 7. The recommended investment period is 5 years. Buyback is not guaranteed and depends, among other things, on the company's liquidity and the board of directors' assessment. A 12-month notice period applies, and for buybacks before 5 years a deduction of 15% may apply.

points.description: We invest exclusively in densely populated areas with documented demand and clear opportunities for realization.
Only projects that meet fixed requirements for location, use, and risk profile are executed.
Renovations are carried out within fixed frameworks for time, quality, and finance.
All investments are assessed with several possible scenarios, including temporary leasing.
Financing is used with care to ensure robustness in the projects.

section_3.p1: For more information, see our Key Investor Information here:

paragraphs.p1: Investors achieve exposure to a portfolio of real estate projects rather than a single project. Risk diversification at the portfolio level is a central element of the company's approach.
Improve Invest A/S is registered with the Danish Financial Supervisory Authority as a manager of alternative investment funds (AIF). It supports a regulated setup.
paragraphs.p2: The regulated setup is an integrated part of the company's way of working and contributes to transparency and investor protection.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest was founded based on a shared desire to create a more transparent, decent, and disciplined way to invest in real estate. We share a fundamental belief that solid value creation does not arise through speculation, but through thorough work, clear processes, and respect for both capital and craftsmanship.
paragraphs.p2: Our collaboration stems not only from a professional common denominator but also from a long-standing personal bond. Improve Invest is therefore built on a foundation where relationships and decency are weighted just as highly as returns.
paragraphs.p3: The motivation to found Improve Invest arose when we experienced a market where many real estate investments were characterized by optimistic market expectations, tax speculation, or a lack of transparency. Our ambition is to create an investment structure where value is created in the process itself: by buying properties with potential, carrying out well-planned renovations, and only realizing the value when the work is done.
paragraphs.p4: What distinguishes Improve Invest from many other players is the work in the tension between investment and practice, and our consistent focus on realized value creation. We do not write up values on an ongoing basis and do not rely on assumptions about general increases in the housing market. Value is only documented when a project is completed and sold. This provides a sober and verifiable approach – both for ourselves and for our investors.
paragraphs.p5: In the long term, we wish to build an asset manager known for discipline, decency, focus, and transparency. Improve Invest should be a place where investors experience clarity in risks, costs, and potential – and where trust is built over time through consistent decisions and responsible management.
paragraphs.p6: Improve Invest was not created to be the biggest – but to be thorough, decent, and value-creating.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest was founded and is run by partners with many years of experience in investment, real estate, and the execution of complex projects. Common to the partners is a disciplined approach to decision-making and a clear focus on the responsible management of investors' capital.

Jacques has more than 25 years of experience from the financial sector with leadership positions in investment, wealth management, and advisory services. He has previously held responsibility for investment and wealth management areas in Danske Bank, Nordea, FIH, Alm. Brand, and most recently Sydbank.
paragraphs.p2: Jacques has also played an active role in industry organizations and board work, including as chairman of the Danish Securities Dealers Association.

paragraphs.p1: Christian has more than 18 years of experience from the real estate and construction industry and has participated in renovation and new build projects totaling more than 17,000 m². He has been a co-owner of development and rental companies and has extensive practical experience with the execution of real estate projects.
paragraphs.p2: Additionally, Christian has held leadership positions in international companies such as Ecolab, Nilfisk, Dyson, and Hempel, where he has worked with structure, processes, and execution.

paragraphs.p1: Claus has many years of experience in the financial sector with strong competencies in management, business development, and corporate advisory. Most recently, he served as a Regional Director at Sydbank, responsible for the bank's activities in North Jutland, where he generated significant growth and strengthened the bank's market position.
paragraphs.p2: Previously, Claus had a long career at Danske Bank focusing on corporate clients, business development, and management. Claus is also an active investor and Chairman of the Board at ScaleHub, as well as an investor in Improve Invest, and actively contributes to the dialogue with both existing and potential investors.

paragraphs.p1: The partners in Improve Invest have invested their own capital in the fund. This ensures that decisions are made with the same interest and risk understanding as the investors – and supports a long-term and responsible approach to the investments.

Improve Invest is organized to deliver a professional, structured, and transparent investment experience. This means clear roles, fixed processes, and a consistent approach to both risk and value creation.
paragraphs.p2: We cooperate with external advisors within auditing, tax, and law to ensure correct structure and ongoing control.

paragraphs.p1: Improve Invest is supported by a professionally competent board with experience in investment, strategy, and governance. The board includes, among others, Christian Klarskov, an investor with many years of experience from the financial markets, and Karsten Holst Bork Kristoffersen, Chairman of the Board and attorney specializing in corporate and capital market matters.
paragraphs.p2: The board contributes with sparring, strategic overview, and a professional basis for decision-making.
paragraphs.p3: Investment in Improve Invest can be made with private capital, via the Business Tax Scheme (VSO), or pension funds. The specific frameworks are always reviewed individually.
